summary: Hobelar dive civ. Lancaster takes sheep fast, puts Manors on the wood line, then dives with 15 to 20 armored Hobelars around minute 9, healing back at the Abbey.
openings: 6 on sheep and 3 on gold, Abbey of Kings, Manor on the wood line, 2 stables plus a range and barracks, and 4 Lords for +20% health.
Spear or tower rush against fast-Castle and 2 TC civs; this only delays their Feudal by about 45 seconds.

spikes.label: Hobelar dive
spikes.detail: Around 9 minutes, 15 to 20 Hobelars with ranged armor and Iron Undermesh dive your villagers, then heal at the Abbey and dive again around 11.
spikes.answer: Spearmen and archers at home, then knights. A tower on your resources helps.

scout: 2 stables in Feudal means a Hobelar dive
A Manor on the wood line
A barracks early against your fast Castle means a spear or tower rush

pairings.why: Mass armored Hobelars healed by the Abbey.

winConditions.detail: Repeated Hobelar dives before map food runs out.

howToBeat: Defend with spear and archer, then go knights.
Malian players open with a tower.
They fall off once map food runs out, so survive the dives.
